news.title: As MAHA champions nutrition, it’s ignoring the experts, dietitians say
news.summary: A key aspect of the Make America Healthy Again agenda could be hampered by a shrinking and underpaid workforce of registered dietitians.

news.title: New guidelines on migraine prevention reflect increasing options for patients
news.summary: “There has been a wealth of new treatment available” for migraine prevention, said a co-author of new guidelines released Monday.

news.summary: President Trump on Monday announced the next round of pricing deals with drugmakers, with nine new companies making such agreements.

news.title: Hospital groups rail against CMS' proposed 340B changes, site-neutral payments
news.summary: Public comments for the latest OPPS proposed rule saw several major hospital groups all but threatening a court showdown over CMS' planned policy changes.

news.title: ChatGPT for Healthcare unveils new integrations with Epic, public health data sources
news.summary: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT's healthcare capabilities with new integrations that connect it more directly with clinical workflows and public healthcare sources.

news.title: UnitedHealthcare to nix prior auth on 1,700 services on Oct. 1
news.summary: UnitedHealthcare said earlier this year that it was aiming to eliminate 30% of prior authorization requirements by the end of 2026.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—ChristianaCare's new CEO begins; Centene names new CIO
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: HHS announces $77M in grants for substance use prevention, treatment
news.summary: Projects supported include those to strengthen substance use prevention, treatment and recovery and suicide prevention.

news.title: Sanford Health, North Memorial Health complete acquisition deal
news.summary: The deal is another attempt from the major rural nonprofit system to enter the Minneapolis market. To do so, it plans a $600 million investment into the two-hospital North Memorial Health, which will help stabilize one financially strained safety-net facility and double the size of the other.

news.title: Nourish embeds generative AI assistant into patient app for 24/7 support
news.summary: The Health Assistant, which has been in beta and is now rolling out widely, gives patients personalized guidance between visits, including meal planning, lab insights and appointment prep support.

news.title: Rural Health Transformation Program funding tracker: CMS awards Arkansas $149.3M; Hawaii receives $58M
news.summary: Stay up-to-date with this tracker for the latest RHTP funding announcements and disclosures.

news.title: Solera Health adds Noom to weight management offerings
news.summary: The partnership will bring Noom Weight, Diabetes Prevention Program and a no-cost GLP-1 companion to Solera Health members.

news.title: 10M expansion state adults risk losing Medicaid coverage over inconsistent work hours
news.summary: About 20% of adults living in Medicaid expansion states will have their eligibility threatened because their work hours may be insufficient or inconsistent under incoming national work requirements, a new study suggests.

news.title: White House unveils next round of MFN pricing deals with 9 midsized drugmakers
news.summary: Some four months after the White House inked the last of its expected drug pricing deals with 17 of the industry’s top players, the U.S. government is back for round 2, this time lining up agreements with a host of medium-sized biopharmas under President Trump’s ‘most favored nation’ agenda.

news.title: McKesson confirms cybersecurity incident as hackers claim millions of patient records stolen
news.summary: Healthcare giant McKesson Corporation confirmed on Friday that it was investigating a cybersecurity incident tied to third-party applications that led to unauthorized access and theft of data.

news.title: ESC: Alnylam's next-gen silencer sees silver linings after fallout of AZ, Ionis trial in ATTR-CM
news.summary: As AstraZeneca appears to close the book on a combo approach following the phase 3 failure of its Ionis-partnered Wainua, several analysts contend it’s too early to count out Alnylam’s silencing drugs in ATTR-CM patients also taking standard-of-care stabilizers.

news.title: Roche inks $1.53B deal for Simcere’s B-cell-targeting antibody
news.summary: Roche is paying oncology-focused Simcere Zaiming $75 million upfront for global rights to a preclinical trispecific antibody targeting B-cell-mediated diseases.

news.title: ArsenalBio sheds most of staff in pivot to in vivo CAR-T
news.summary: About a year after halving its staff in a clinical push, Arsenal Biosciences is now making a hard pivot that involves laying off most of its employees and seeking out new homes for its assets.

news.title: Medtronic recalls reflux monitoring device as 184 serious injuries linked to capsule
news.summary: Medtronic is recalling certain esophageal pH monitoring capsule delivery devices amid risks of them failing whilst deployed.

news.title: Alumis crushed by midstage lupus flop but plots path to phase 3 for TYK2 inhibitor
news.summary: A phase 2b lupus trial of Alumis’ envudeucitinib has missed its primary and secondary endpoints. But the biotech is still moving the TYK2 inhibitor into phase 3 in the autoimmune disease, pointing to evidence of efficacy in a prespecified subgroup of patients to support its decision.

news.title: Novocure hit by cyberattack exposing patient data
news.summary: Novocure has become the latest medtech company to be hit by a cyberattack, with the oncology specialist revealing that unauthorized access to some of its information systems exposed patient and employee data.

news.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: ArsenalBio winnows down workforce; Kolon cuts staff
news.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

news.title: Boston Scientific halts sales of angiographic catheters amid 2 serious injuries
news.summary: Boston Scientific has told its customers to stop using its Imager II angiographic catheters upon learning that a manufacturing issue has impacted the tips of the devices.

news.title: GSK catches phase 3 fever after mRNA flu vaccine beats standard shots
news.summary: GSK has linked its mRNA seasonal flu vaccine candidate to higher immune responses than conventional jabs in a phase 2 trial, emboldening the company to start a pivotal study this month.

news.title: UPDATED: Novartis halts autoimmune CAR-T trials after 3 deaths, as BMS also pauses studies
news.summary: Three deaths have forced Novartis to pause development of its CD19 CAR-T candidate in autoimmune diseases, just as Bristol Myers Squibb has halted a similar program due to immune-related adverse events, Fierce has learned.

news.title: Natera teams with Angiex on cancer drug trial monitoring
news.summary: Natera inked a collaboration deal with biotech Angiex to assess the use of its Signatera blood test, which looks for small traces of cancer DNA in patients who have been diagnosed and treated for the disease.

news.title: Electra aims to light up Nasdaq with IPO for phase 2/3 I&I push
news.summary: The 2026 IPO streak continues as Electra Therapeutics has filed to go public to support its immunology and cancer pipeline.

papers.title: DiagEvo: Diagnosis-Guided Self-Evolution via Hierarchical Error Memory
papers.summary: Self-play is an effective paradigm for language-model self-evolution, but without guidance, solver performance can plateau or decline across rounds. Unguided methods steer question generation with signals such as difficulty, learnability, or diversity. These signals keep questions challenging and varied but do not specify which unresolved reasoning weaknesses later rounds should target.
